# /admin-team — Admin & Ops Team

> Backed up 2026-11-10. Call the whole team with `/admin-team`; it goes to the lead.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Team | Admin & Ops Team |
| Call name | `/admin-team` |
| Lead | [`/bot-proofy`](../../bots/bot-proofy/README.md) |
| Members | 7 |

## Purpose

Business admin, email, grants, settings, projects and outreach.

## Routing

MailClerk drafts email; FreedomAngelOps and CAGECodeClerk handle entity/registration (secrets via Secret/Proofy); GrantHunter reports matches to Proofy; SettingsSteward audits paid-app settings; Projects Manager runs Notion projects; Outbound Prospecting drafts outreach. Money/secrets escalate to Proofy.

## Members

| Call name | Bot | Role |
|---|---|---|
| [`/bot-mailclerk`](../../bots/bot-mailclerk/README.md) | MailClerk | Email assistant; drafts, never sends without a yes |
| [`/bot-freedomangelops`](../../bots/bot-freedomangelops/README.md) | FreedomAngelOps | Freedom Angel Corp operations |
| [`/bot-cagecodeclerk`](../../bots/bot-cagecodeclerk/README.md) | CAGECodeClerk | Federal-registration recovery and inventory (via vault, no secrets in chat) |
| [`/bot-granthunter`](../../bots/bot-granthunter/README.md) | GrantHunter | Finds grants Audrey qualifies for |
| [`/bot-settingssteward`](../../bots/bot-settingssteward/README.md) | SettingsSteward | Paid-app settings and unused paid features, one app at a time |
| [`/bot-projects-manager`](../../bots/bot-projects-manager/README.md) | Projects Manager | Runs projects from Notion; specialist bots claim tasks |
| [`/bot-outbound-prospecting`](../../bots/bot-outbound-prospecting/README.md) | Outbound Prospecting | Finds prospects and drafts first messages; nothing sends without a yes |

## Rules

All members follow [BOT-COMMON-RULES.md](../../BOT-COMMON-RULES.md) plus each bot's own rules in its README.

## How to re-create the team

1. Re-create each member from its README ("How to re-create"), lead first.
2. Tell every member who the lead is and where to report.
3. Point Audrey's requests for this team at `/bot-proofy`.
